findings.issue_summary: False-positive triage: no race or ethnicity source
findings.evidence: All supplied race-pattern files were inspected. Matches are printStackTrace exception diagnostics, not race/ethnicity fields. GeminiNanoCoachManager processes user text through the on-device ML Kit Generation client; AppVersionManager copies an installed APK locally and invokes Package Installer; DynamicIconManager updates local component settings. No ethnicity source or transfer identified.
findings.recommendation: Prune the RACE_ETHNICITY heuristic match from collection declarations unless future functionality actually collects this type.

findings.evidence: EyeExerciseOverlayService.kt:243-249 obtains only TYPE_LIGHT, an ambient illumination sensor, not a body/health sensor. Derived eye/blink/fatigue variables in the same service feed local overlays and notifications (lines 99-224, 270-299, 350-382) and local score preferences (lines 255-267, 648-665). GazeTracker.kt:52-89 analyzes InputImage using bundled ML Kit face detection and returns local results; no upload sink found.
findings.recommendation: Document local eye-feature processing and keep unsupported physiological claims separate from Data Safety collection; verify SDK disclosures against release configuration.

findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt:166-180 requests CAMERA; no photo picker/gallery read or upload in this path. EyeExerciseOverlayService.kt:624-646 binds camera image analysis; imageProxy flows to GazeTracker.processImageProxy. GazeTracker.kt:50-96 passes frames to bundled ML Kit FaceDetection, emits in-memory face/eye callbacks, and closes imageProxy. No image save, network client or upload sink observed in this path. Gradle declares bundled face-detection, MediaPipe and on-device GenAI rather than analytics/ad SDKs.
findings.recommendation: Describe transient on-device camera frame processing accurately; do not declare gallery photos collected merely from CAMERA permission. Recheck merged dependencies and any future frame recording or transfer.
